# Adarsh B A - Engineering Journal

> Official engineering journal and technical research publications of Adarsh B A.
> Main publication: https://blog.adhi.is-a.dev
> Portfolio: https://adhi.is-a.dev
> Author: Adarsh B A (Full-Stack Software Engineer)

## About This Publication
Adarsh's Engineering Journal focuses on in-depth analysis of scalable systems, modern frontend architecture, database engineering, and distributed cloud applications.

## Key Topics Covered
- High-performance web architectures (Next.js, React, Web Workers, Service Workers)
- Database modeling, offline fallback synchronization, and RBAC policies
- Real-time communication protocols (WebRTC, WebSockets, STUN/TURN)
- Security hardening (Zero-trust architecture, CSRF/XSS mitigation, rate-limiting)
